#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <set>

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    std::vector<int> subset_sums1, subset_sums2;
    int half = n / 2;

    auto compute_sums_first = [&](int i, int total = 0) {
        if (i == half) {
            subset_sums1.push_back(total % m);
        } else {
            compute_sums_first(i + 1, total + a[i]);
            compute_sums_first(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    auto compute_sums_second = [&](int i, int total = 0) {
        if (i == n) {
            subset_sums2.push_back(total % m);
        } else {
            compute_sums_second(i + 1, total + a[i]);
            compute_sums_second(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    compute_sums_first(0);
    compute_sums_second(half);

    int best = 0;
    std::set<int> unique_sums(subset_sums1.begin(), subset_sums1.end());
    std::vector<int> sorted_sums(unique_sums.begin(), unique_sums.end());

    for (int i : subset_sums2) {
        int target = m - i;
        auto it = std::lower_bound(sorted_sums.begin(), sorted_sums.end(), target);
        if (it != sorted_sums.begin()) {
            int candidate = *(it - 1) + i;
            if (candidate > best) {
                best = candidate;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << best << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
